lead_with.title: Montreal is a payments city
lead_with.text: Montreal is home to payments and commerce players such as **Nuvei** and **Lightspeed**, and **Desjardins**, a major Quebec card issuer. Finance Montréal can open doors for network and partner discussions in Canada.

lead_with.title: A New York-hours base for international teams
lead_with.text: A Finance Montréal-commissioned Boyd study puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M a year in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**, in the New York time zone. Bilingual talent and strong **AI and fraud-analytics** research help network, partner support and risk teams.

lead_with.title: The IFC tax credit
lead_with.text: Quebec's **International Financial Centre** credit can reach **C$18,000 per eligible employee per year**, including for services provided under contract to a **foreign affiliate** (compliance, data, IT, fund and transaction support). Eligibility is checked case by case.

company.text: Capital One is one of the largest US credit card issuers and banks (HQ McLean, Virginia), CEO **Richard Fairbank**. After buying **Discover** in 2025 it owns a card network: debit cards have already moved to Discover rails, and it is now **gradually moving credit cards** and issuing new cards on the network. Management has discussed **improving acceptance of Discover cards abroad** (American Banker, Oct 21, 2026). Its International Market Development team manages **partner relationships across North America** and grows **commercial payments in North and Latin America** (per Capital One job postings).

financials.text: **Q3 2026** (released Oct 20, 2026): net income **US$3.5B**, diluted EPS **US$5.61** (adjusted **US$6.69**); total net revenue **US$16.3B** (+3% vs Q2). Discover integration expenses **US$338M** in the quarter; CEO says synergies are on track. Target: add **US$175B+** of purchase volume to the Discover network by 2027.
